profile_text.body:
Gong is a for-profit startup founded in 2015 and headquartered in Palo Alto, CA. The company describes itself as offering a "Revenue AI OS," a platform it positions as serving go-to-market organizations through what it calls multimodal revenue signal processing, specialized AI agents, and purpose-built sales applications. Its stated aims include closing deals faster, predicting pipeline risk, automating handoffs, and reducing customer churn.

Gong's core product suite includes Gong Engage, described as a tool for prioritizing and personalizing sales communications, and Gong Enable, which includes an AI Trainer feature the company says allows sales teams to create training scenarios grounded in recorded customer conversations. The site also references an AI Tracker agent, which a quoted customer credits with lifting buyer response rates by 32% and saving 6,700 hours across call preparation, follow-up, and CRM updates. The platform is categorized on this site under Notes, Knowledge and Meetings, with a noted concern around sensitive sales data exposure.

The held facts include two MCP server listings associated with SQLite database tooling under the Gong name, though these appear to be third-party community entries rather than official Gong products. No litigation or SEC filings are recorded for the company at this time.
